item.title: Incarico post-doc: Comparative evaluation procedure for n. 1 post-doc research contract - Department of Veterinary Medical Sciences (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Cesena
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-09 Scienze e tecnologie animali

Title of the project: " Conservation of the European eel (Anguilla anguilla): improving knowledge of the life cycle of eels and developing aquaculture techniques for their farming ". The project aims to acquire new knowledge on the reproductive biology of the European eel, with the objective of improving understanding of its life cycle, migratory patterns, and the techniques required to achieve closure of the life cycle under controlled conditions. To this end, knowledge concerning the life cycle of other anguillid species found worldwide will also be explored, in order to identify approaches and strategies applicable to captive rearing for aquaculture purposes. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Characterisation and validation of winemaking yeasts for the improvement of the quality of sparkling wines produced using the Classic and Charmat methods (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-06 23:59
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-08 Microbiologia agraria, alimentare e ambientale

The research will be carried out at the Department of Agricultural, Food and Forest Sciences at the University of Palermo and at the wineries of the partner organisations in the White Wine Identity project. The programme will focus on the characterisation of winemaking yeasts intended for the production of sparkling wines using the Classic and Charmat methods. Activities will include the assessment of the fermentative performance of the strains used during the refermentation and second fermentation stages, monitoring of the production processes, and the development of innovative sparkling wine production protocols. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Dynamics of the grapevine microbiome in response to treatments for sustainable disease management (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-06 23:59
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-05 Patologia vegetale ed entomologia

The research activities will focus on evaluating the impact of sustainable plant protection treatments on the management of the major grapevine diseases, as well as on the structure, composition, and diversity of the bacterial and fungal microbial communities associated with the plant. The experimental activities will include the design of the experimental plan and sampling protocol, the assessment of disease incidence and severity using appropriate phytopathological indices and rating scales, plant material sampling, sample preparation, and DNA extraction. item.title: Incarico post-doc: AgNUE Agricultural Nitrogen Use Efficiency Platform (Univ. BASILICATA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-28 23:59
Institution: Univ. BASILICATA, Potenza
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-02 Agronomia e sistemi colturali erbacei e ortofloricoli

The project aims to improve the nitrogen use efficiency (NUE) of agricultural crops and reduce nitrogen losses, with a focus on N₂O emissions, while contributing to the development of more resilient agroecosystems. AgNUE extends its scope by establishing a global research platform aimed at mitigating N₂O emissions through field measurements, modeling innovation, and high-quality data production. Experimentation and data collection are planned at supersites, farms, fields, and laboratories. These activities require the implementation of sensors and instruments related to emissions and nitrogen balance that take into account the spatial and temporal variability of the soil-plant-atmosphere…
